question: Should this issue remain the canonical Linux companion app tracker now that Windows Hub ships, and which Linux app candidate path should maintainers sponsor or reject?
rationale: The remaining work is not a narrow source fix: it requires app architecture, packaging, gateway/auth boundaries, installer provenance, and security review decisions.

options.title: Keep Canonical And Choose Linux Path
options.body: Keep this issue open as the umbrella, review the open Linux PR candidates against security and packaging requirements, and split only concrete Windows Hub follow-ups.

options.title: Split Linux Into A Narrower Tracker
options.body: Open a focused Linux companion app design/release issue, transfer the Linux PR context there, and close this issue after the split is explicitly linked.

options.title: Defer Companion Apps
options.body: Mark the Linux companion app direction as deferred until security/setup priorities are complete, leaving Windows Hub bugs to dedicated issues.

recommendation.title: Keep Canonical And Choose Linux Path
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the umbrella, review the open Linux PR candidates against security and packaging requirements, and split only concrete Windows Hub follow-ups.

likelyOwner.reason: This person opened the tracker and provided the clearest product-direction comments on GTK-native Linux app expectations.
